source_note: See data/wow_spells/README.md for the schema. Every entry's values are read live from its own WoW: Forever Wowhead spell tooltip (wowhead.com/forever/spell=<wowhead_spell_id>) unless "notes" says otherwise. Covers only the Enhancement single-target rotation pieces reachable in an 11-point level-20 build, like the other class passes.
gaps: Real, explicit source caveat: Icy Veins' own guide says the level-20 Enhancement toolkit is too limited to show the spec's real playstyle yet ("the full playstyle isn't really on display yet until we see more of the Beta open up") -- this class's real level-20 kit is genuinely thinner than every other class catalogued so far, not an artifact of under-research this pass.

None of Stormstrike, Flurry, Maelstrom Weapon or Windfury Weapon (Enhancement's real signature abilities in other WoW versions) are reachable at 11 points and none are named in the real level-20 rotation text -- not looked up.

Lightning Shield, Flametongue Weapon (group alternative to Rockbiter), Frost Shock, Fire Nova, totems (Searing/Strength of Earth/Stoneskin/Healing Stream) named in the real rotation but not looked up.

"talents.elemental" and "talents.restoration" are empty placeholders. Note: the guide also flags a real alternative build spending points in Restoration (Mindfulness + Water Shield) for better early Mana sustain, at the cost of blocking a deeper Enhancement path later -- not sourced here.

abilities.notes: Rank 3 is the max rank trainable by level 20 (Rank 4 requires level 24). Also interrupts spellcasting and locks out that school for 2 sec -- a secondary utility effect alongside the damage. Real single-target priority (Icy Veins): cast when solo (Frost Shock is the group alternative, to avoid pulling threat).

Rank 3 is the max rank trainable by level 20 (Rank 4 requires level 24). A 60-minute weapon-imbue buff (+118 melee Attack Power), not a rotational damage ability -- more like a long-duration maintenance buff (comparable in role to Warrior's Battle Shout) than a spell recast on cooldown. Real single-target priority (Icy Veins): use when solo; Flametongue Weapon is the group alternative (not sourced).

enhancement.notes: Real level-20 build takes 5/5 ("bulk Critical Strike", per Icy Veins; exact per-rank amount not looked up).
Real level-20 build takes 3/3 ("enables Intellect as a key stat", per Icy Veins -- likely converts some Intellect into Attack Power or similar; exact effect not looked up).
Real level-20 build takes 2/2, but explicitly a mobility/utility pick with "no throughput" per Icy Veins' own text -- taken for its non-combat value, not DPS.

enhancement.effect_per_rank: Reduces the Mana cost of Shocks (e.g. Earth Shock) after a critical strike, per Icy Veins' text
enhancement.notes: Real level-20 build takes 1/1, described as "the goal early" pick to sustain Shock usage on a limited Mana pool.
